format: The "where" sentence a notification carries. kind=where: input {now, dish, newton, places [{key, area}], hours {place: DiningHallHours}, grab? {place: window}, days {isoDate: {place: {meal: [dish names]}}}} -> expected {groups, sentences}. now is an absolute instant (ISO 8601 with offset), read as Eastern wall time. groups is wherePlan (app/lib/core/m2/where.dart) as WhereGroup.toJson, soonest first; sentences[k] is whenText(groups[k], groups[k-1]). newton is always false: the server never answers for the Charles River places (area 4). The source is Dart: regenerate with `cd app && dart run tool/where_vectors.dart`; never hand-edit expected.

cases.name: now, until: lunch at one hall, mid-lunch
from: dinner is later today
two halls in the same meal share one group, halls in W F H B order
several groups: lunch now at W, F closes earlier (Until), dinner from, tomorrow
several groups: breakfast and lunch later, same state different meal
last serving ended: no group, no sentence
window is half-open at close: 4:00 PM is past
only tomorrow is left
dish key: case, curly apostrophe and & fold
a dish not on the menu
2 AM rollover: 1:30 AM, own late-night window 9 PM to 2 AM
2 AM rollover: 11 PM, synthesized late night 9 PM to 2 AM reads as past (close before open)
2 AM rollover: 1:30 AM, synthesized late night is not yet open
noon and midnight read as words
hours not known for a hall: it serves nothing
a hall with no general hours has no synthesized meal
newton false: a Charles River place is left out
newton false: the halls still answer when a Charles River place serves it too
a cafe all-day menu
a hall Grab N Go window
